title: Is the ATS rejecting my resume?! #atsfriendlyresume #howtogetajob #resumetips
description:
I debunk the biggest myth about the Applicant Tracking System (ATS). It's not auto-rejecting your resume. The reasons for rejection are qualification, application fit, or location.
